title: What Breaks Your Heart
subtitle: care becoming specific
mapEpigraph: You are not heartbroken by everything.

prompts.text: What can you not scroll past?
How long has this particular care been awake?
What scale of response would honor it without consuming you?
What breaks my heart—and where does my care become specific?

blocks.title: One form
blocks.instruction: Give the heartbreak one form: a sentence, image, gesture, donation, boundary, or act of attention. Choose the scale that does not consume you.

blocks.closing: Let yourself be moved without making yourself responsible for everything.
